source_text: European human rights frameworks, including Article 9 of the European Convention on Human Rights, have upheld religious circumcision against blanket bans, as in a 2015 Dutch court dismissal of assault claims against parents, emphasizing proportionality and lack of severe risk when hygienically performed.
